text:
ash: Quick heads-up: Console is going to emit `x-route-hint` and `x-quota-tag` in the canary. Need SDK guidance on propagation + light telemetry.

mina: are these headers only for observability or do they affect routing decisions downstream?

ash: both. Initially observability but we'll start honoring `x-route-hint` on some internal proxies.

jia: SDKs currently strip unknown headers in the HTTP helper. We should either: (A) add opt-in passthrough for `x-route-*` and `x-quota-*`, or (B) explicitly map a handful of headers into ClientOptions.

ops-bot: canary deploy scheduled: console/flag/route-quota-hints -> group=internal at 2026-04-02T08:00Z

mina: my vote: opt-in passthrough by pattern + denylist for sensitive buckets. Keep default off during canary.

seb: telemetry ask: emit counter `sdk.forwarded_route_hint` and attach tag `quota_tag` when we forward. Console will join these with applied routing metrics.

noor: security note: sanitize values. Only allow `[-_a-zA-Z0-9:]` and max length 128. Drop otherwise and increment a metric `sdk.route_header_sanitized`.

jia: implementation plan: TS/Py expose `forward_route_headers` (bool) + `route_header_patterns` (list) default [] ; Go add `WithRouteHeaderPassthrough`. Add small unit tests and an integration test hitting canary console. PRs today.

ash: docs + changelog: brief advisory "If you rely on server-provided routing hints, enable passthrough or upgrade SDK." We'll publish before canary.

mina: good. Ops to monitor `sdk.forwarded_route_hint` and `console.route_applied` panels. Revert if routes misapplied.

ash: thanks. follow-up sync Thursday 16:00 UTC.
